decision.reason: [ev-7b384eb00d22] only says that the `validation.enforce-metric-name` CLI flag and its YAML setting are removed, listed under "Deprecated configuration options are removed". It does not say what happens if an environment still sets them. The value might be silently ignored, or Loki might fail at startup on an unknown flag or key, so the claim that it "will be ignored" (setting-ignored, high) has no support. We need evidence stating how Loki 3.0.0 handles this flag or YAML key when it is still configured, for example the config parsing behaviour or a changelog entry.
